invariants.text: User.user_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.user_id must reference an existing User.user_id
An order must be associated with a user via the user_id field.
Only users with the is_admin flag set to true can modify products.
Only users with the is_admin flag set to true can modify other users' records.
A user can only create orders if they exist in the system.
An order's status must be one of the valid status values defined in the system.
The price of a product must be greater than zero.
A user can only view their own orders, not those of other users.
The order_date of an order must be set to the current date and time when the order is created.
A product must have a name and a price field with a positive value.
An order must have a valid user_id that references an existing user in the system.
